summary: Chancellor is urged to ‘get a grip’ on the nation’s finances as yield on 30-year bond rises to 5.62% The cost of UK government borrowing has jumped to near a 27-year high, piling pressure on Rachel Reeves to reveal how she will tackle the deficit in the public finances ahead of the autumn budget.
